title: orbit.yaml
description: Configuration of an orbit project: the services orbit launches, controls and monitors.

name.description: Project name (default: the name of the directory).

compose.description: docker-compose file(s) to import as services. By default the compose file next to orbit.yaml is imported; `false` imports none.

compose_project.description: Compose project name used for the imported services.

env.description: Variables for all services. ${VAR} and ${VAR:-def} are interpolated (also from .env).

shell.description: Shell that runs cmd, hooks, health and console (default: sh, or cmd.exe on Windows).

services.description: The services of the project, by name.

groups.description: Named sets of services, to start or stop together.

stringList.description: A string or a list of strings.

duration.description: A duration: 500ms, 2s, 1m, 1h (a bare number is milliseconds).

number.description: A number (a string is accepted because ${VAR} is interpolated before it is read).

env.description: Environment variables: a mapping, or a list of KEY=value.

envFile.description: .env file(s): a path, or { path, required: false } if optional; a list of either.

required.description: A missing required file is an error (default true).

health.description: How orbit knows the service is up. Shortcuts: "http://…", "tcp:5432", "container", or a command. `false` disables the default TCP check on `port`.

http.description: URL that must answer with a status < 500.

tcp.description: host:port (or just port) that must accept connections.

container.description: Use the container's own Docker HEALTHCHECK.

timeout.description: Time a single check may take (default 2s).

readyWhen.description: Extra readiness condition read from the service's output. With `health`, both must pass.

log.description: Substring, or "/regex/flags", that a stdout/stderr line must match, e.g. "Listening on".

watch.description: Restart the service when matching files change: a list of globs, or { paths, ignore, debounce, cooldown }.

paths.description: Globs relative to the service's cwd.

ignore.description: .git, node_modules and editor swap files are always ignored.

debounce.description: Quiet time needed after the last change (default 1s).

cooldown.description: At most one restart per cooldown; changes in between are batched (default 10s).

hook.description: A command, { cmd, timeout }, or a list of them (run in order, stopping at the first failure).

timeout.description: Time before the hook is killed and counts as failed (default 60s).

service.description: A service: an object, or just its command as a string.

type.description: process (cmd), docker (image), compose (from docker-compose.yml) or external (only health-checked). Inferred when omitted.

cmd.description: Command to run (process), or the command override (docker).

shell.description: Shell for this service's cmd, hooks, health and console.

console.description: Interactive command for the `i` key (psql, rails console…). Process: runs in cwd/env; docker: inside the container.

cwd.description: Working directory, relative to the project root.

env.description: Variables for this service; they override the ones read from env_file.

env_file.description: .env files read every time the service starts.

depends_on.description: Services that must be ready before this one starts.

port.description: Main host port: occupied-port check, default TCP health, and the `o` key.

oneshot.description: A task that runs to completion: ready once it exits 0.

pre_start.description: Runs before launching; if it fails the service is `failed`.

post_start.description: Runs once the service is ready; a failure is only reported. Not allowed on oneshot tasks.

post_stop.description: Runs whenever the service goes down, however it went down.

restart.description: Restart policy, with exponential backoff (1s → 30s). Default: no.

start_timeout.description: Time to wait for the service to become ready (default 60s).

stop_timeout.description: Time to wait after SIGTERM before SIGKILL (default 8s).

mem_limit.description: Memory alert threshold: 512m, 1.5G, or bytes. orbit alerts; it does not enforce it.

leak_detection.description: Warn about sustained memory growth (default true).

image.description: Docker image (makes it a docker service).

volumes.description: Docker volumes; relative host paths resolve against the project root.

service.description: Name of the service in the compose file (makes it a compose service).
